# Hollinwood Estate Office - archive workspace

Working area for the estate archive.

- archive/  the series code each record class is filed under

The series code of a record class is fixed by the filing scheme and the index is edited in place, so a class is never filed under two series. Entries are kept in the order the series were opened. Last reviewed 2025-12-15, reference HE-6630.
